async def act(page):
    # Wait for the page to fully load to ensure all elements are available
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Find the comment textbox using the exact role and name from the accessibility tree
    comment_textbox = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Comment')
    await comment_textbox.wait_for(state='visible')
    
    # Fill the comment textbox with 'Good idea'
    await comment_textbox.fill('Good idea')
    
    # Find and click the submit button for the comment with exact matching
    submit_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Comment', exact=True)
    await submit_button.click()
    
    # Wait for the comment to be posted and page to update
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
